issues.description: Method naming mismatch for the order-processing routine: the problem statement (UML and textual requirements) specifies a method named checkOrderReady() with signature void checkOrderReady() that is called to attempt serving queued orders. The reference solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java) instead implements this behavior in a method named processOrders() and orderMeal() calls processOrders(). Because the specification and tests refer to checkOrderReady(), the different identifier in the solution can confuse students and break automated checks that expect the exact method name.
issues.suggestedFix: Expose the method name required by the specification. Either rename processOrders() to checkOrderReady() (and keep its implementation), and have orderMeal() call checkOrderReady(); or add a public void checkOrderReady() method that delegates to the existing processOrders() implementation. Update documentation/UML accordingly so tests and students use the same API.
